required_checks: independently reconstruct every trace and target block from the published clone/join recipe
directly compute every pair projection and the opposition edge set
replay the unique-color certificate and every edge and negative witness
check full block projection caps and empty-negative rejection
verify sparse edge counts and the exact missing clone rectangle

proof_controls.q_plus_one: For q=1..4, independently construct q+1 positives on unequal nonempty blocks of sizes 3,2,1; verify q local words per block and q+1 distinct projections on every cross-block pair, and require a replayable sparse certificate.
proof_controls.unequal_three_positive_counterexample: Replay the retained sizes-(2,4) q=2 case; pair {b,f} has only bbff and ffbb, so it is absent from the expected complete bipartite graph. Also verify the sparse provider still certifies the target partition.
proof_controls.interpretation: The q+1 formula is a sufficient construction, not a universal lower bound. The unequal counterexample refutes only the naive unequal-size extension of the specified equal-size three-positive construction.

capture: Capture this protocol and driver, the provider, scale fixture, source construction/protocol, proof addendum, q proof, minimized counterexample and its original fixture, plus evidence/capture.py before execution.
performance: Correctness validation only. No time or memory results. Official performance remains prohibited until explicit master GO.
